tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the everyday tasks RealRun has tested AI models on, with item counts, test dates, results pages and playbook prices.

tools.name: get_scores
tools.description: Headline scores for every model RealRun tested on a task, best first, with cost tier and the metric definition.

tools.name: recommend_model
tools.description: Recommend which AI model to use for a task given a priority: 'accuracy', 'cost' or 'balanced'. Never recommends models RealRun flagged as not recommended.

tools.name: get_warnings
tools.description: Models RealRun flagged as not recommended or needing caution on a task (scam failures, invented data, inconsistency).
